final: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifacts_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, CAST(f.articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.artifacts_total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifacts_total IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - m.value AS difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
